API Module¶

Views¶

API Views for the News application.

Provides RESTful endpoints for: - Articles (CRUD, approval, filtering) - Newsletters (CRUD) - Approved article notifications - Subscription-based article retrieval

All endpoints use Django REST Framework.

api.views.approve_article(request, *args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Allows editors to approve an article.

Once approved: - Email notification is sent - External API endpoint is triggered

api.views.approved_articles(request, *args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Returns all articles that have been approved by an editor.

Public endpoint for retrieving published content.

api.views.approved_log(request, *args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Receives log data for approved articles.

Simulates external system integration.

api.views.article_detail(request, *args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Retrieves a single article by its ID.

api.views.create_article_api(request, *args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Allows journalists to create new articles via API.

The logged-in user is set as the article author.

api.views.create_newsletter(request, *args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Allows journalists and editors to create newsletters via API.

The logged-in user is set as the author.

api.views.delete_article(request, *args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Allows journalists and editors to delete an article via API.

api.views.delete_newsletter(request, *args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Allows journalists and editors to delete newsletters via API.

api.views.newsletters(request, *args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Returns all newsletters in the system.

Accessible only to authenticated users.

api.views.subscribed_articles(request, *args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Returns articles based on the user’s subscriptions.

Includes: - Articles from subscribed journalists - Articles from subscribed publishers

api.views.update_article(request, *args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Allows journalists and editors to update an existing article.

api.views.update_newsletter(request, *args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Allows journalists and editors to update a newsletter.
